title: Quentin and the Signal
author: August Blackwood
blurb: Ines Blackwood, the caretaker of Earth's abandoned seed vault, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. Then gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep before the jump window closes.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
